svg.text: A small square computer. Blueprint for 3D printing, drawn from the CAD (nimbus_cad.py). Dimensions in mm.
one slim strip: two USB-C and a round jack
finger scoop: a small flat-floored recess in the back face, wall kept at 2.4
screws go up from underneath; the flat rear pad is the foot
front shell and back cover, apart
teardrop standoffs and the screw holes bridge
back panel down on the bed
the port windows sit in the first layers
2 x M3 x 12 self-tapping from underneath, at (-62, 70), (62, 70)
4 x M2.5 x 6 for the Pi 4 on teardrop standoffs, board 26 mm off the floor
wall 2.4 mm everywhere; one 0.5 mm reveal, half-lap joint
display (stand-in 16:9 panel): 194 x 110 glass, 176 x 99 active, glued to a 2 mm ledge
the display numbers are stand-ins: check them with calipers before printing
the front leans 6 degrees back; the flat rear pad is the foot, so the chin hovers
Joshua Tree OS, hardware, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
